ambiguous_activation; no tap and no callback; exactly two eligible Button leaves preserved as evidence

label selector uniquely resolves actual native Button without an identifier

pass with actual true and known native Button leaf

upward return from distant bottom; overlapping capture chain; fully visible native tap
identifier-free target resolved by label and native role after downward reveal

baseline_expectations.semantic: Known baseline resolves only Switch semantic types; generic Button/Switch containing groups may be tapped as containers, disabled activation leaf state may not be considered. Preserve evidence, classify individually.
baseline_expectations.long: Baseline global seen/bottom set does not establish per-state continuous coverage. 940-point cap.tall cannot become fully visible and should cause required-identifier failure. Baseline cannot express label selectors or activation enabled assertions; mark unrepresentable rather than source-only runtime pass.
